svg.text: The shape steps of the object step, on a small picture
One square = one 5 cm cell. close_radius = split_radius = 2 cells. I ran the same grow and shrink rules on this example.

g.text: two blocks, a thin bridge, a 2 × 2 hole
the bridge (red) is 3 cells wide: cut away
O4 and O5. Labels, then the cut cells go back
the bridge is split halfway, left half to 1, right half to 2

svg.text: A gap of up to 4 cells (20 cm) is filled; a part up to 4 cells wide is cut. 5 cells (25 cm) or more stays.
